components.name: linkbox-api
components.responsibility:
Owns the server-side business logic: saving and tagging links, managing collections,
publishing and revoking share tokens, and enforcing per-user access on every request.
Persists the domain entities and serves the Connect RPC surface the web app calls.

components.name: linkbox-web
components.responsibility:
The Svelte web client: the single save field and library list, the tag editor, and the
collection publish/share UI. Calls linkbox-api over Connect and renders the read-only
public collection view for share-link visitors.
